headline: Ask Which, Not How Good: Sizing Benchmarks Scored by an LLM
summary: A measurement study of 373,019 LLM judgments reports a hard limit on the resolution of single-judge pointwise benchmarks: increasing item count cannot remove system-by-judge variance. Pairwise scoring reduces that variance in the tested setup but introduces an 8.6-point presentation-order effect. Across the studied benchmarks, measured 95% floors of 0.41–1.24 points exceeded the median reported gain of 0.28 points; all 17 recovered MT-Bench gains in the matched comparison fell below that benchmark’s measured floor. These are author-reported findings, not an independent replication.
